measured_contract.definition: semantic_version is TUNING.semantic_version (operation semantics); candidate_contract_version is TUNING.candidate_contract_version (candidate enumeration/eligibility, not a candidate index). config_schema_version was not separately recorded for this collection and is not inferred from current source. Current TUNING is not proof of the historical dirty implementation.

included_fields: case ID, shape, corpus, dtype, kind and measurement_context
per-phase two-sided raw samples and medians, ratio, cache and timing mode
original block order, sample ranges, monotonic start/end per block
per-side pre/post output and amplitude checks and input restoration
per-case parity, closed, correctness/graph/live-mutation summary and counts
not_a_full_lifecycle_export: No raw lifecycle bindings, capture or allocator addresses, mutation input tensors, full mutation checks/amplitudes or detailed memory stats.

Original logs, process observations, wall-clock epochs, untracked inventory and complete selection/bundles/records are not published in this repository; full lifecycle gates cannot be independently replayed.
export.ratio_direction: b12x median / DeepGEMM median (lower is better)
export.threshold_definition: Every required phase of every case must have ratio <=1.01, not only the aggregate geomean. A paired phase has one side record per arm; a confirmation is a case with both additional paired phases. See ../grouped-fp8.md for raw field definitions.
export.csv_scope: Only semantic-3 measurements. Join by case and measurement_context; semantic-4/review timings are separate.

measurement_context_definition: File-local context-1 through context-5 join companion cases and CSV rows to the original batch environment observations below. All five used the same card and repository bases. Each context is a separate collection-process monotonic clock domain, not a task address or source identity; cross-context timestamps are not a shared epoch and file line order is not timing order.
monitoring_limits: monitor_observations and monitor_conflicts retain original observation/conflict counts. Monitoring method and coverage are not published; zero conflicts does not prove continuous exclusivity or absence of interference. exclusive_visibility:null means unknown/not provided, not an exclusive-device verdict.

source_repositories_coordinate_system: Paths are relative to the historical external multi-repository workspace, not this b12x checkout; '.' is the external harness repository. Revisions are repository Git bases, not exact dirty-source revisions.
evidence_availability: Companion raw timings and selected correctness summaries are published. Additional declared inputs, exact dirty/untracked sources, complete logs and lifecycle records are not. The external harness/corpus/formal drivers have no public fetch entry here and are not provided by this repository; these paired measurements cannot be reproduced from this repository alone.
hardware_identity: gpu-1 is run-local; all five contexts used one card. The same pseudonym in another collection does not establish cross-collection card identity. Snapshot clocks do not establish sustained clocks or absence of throttling.

version_notes.recorded_during_preparation: Preparation checks report CUDA runtime 13.0, Python 3.12.14 and torch 2.14.0+cu130; driver/runtime observations are separate. nvcc/CUTLASS DSL/triton versions were not individually recorded.

boundaries: TUNING.semantic_version 3, candidate_contract_version 8 applies to this measured tree only; semantic-4 decode covers 446 cases with different dirty sources
Earlier sequential measurements remain separate. Earlier failed performance attempts remain failures and are excluded from passing phases; complete failure records are not published.
not a whole-upstream-suite, SM121 or EP1/EP8 scaling qualification
